reasoning: 1. TARGET ENGAGEMENT: No biomarker or PD data available to assess whether nivolumab engaged PD-1, ipilimumab engaged CTLA-4, or Optune delivered effective tumor treating fields. 2. PATHWAY MODULATION: No pathway biomarkers reported to confirm downstream immune activation or tumor cell disruption. 3. CLINICAL TRANSLATION: Trial was terminated early due to low accrual (n=2) during COVID-19 pandemic. With only 2 patients and median follow-up of 53 days, no meaningful efficacy assessment was possible. Primary endpoint of intracranial PFS at 6 months could not be evaluated. 4. POPULATION EFFECTS: Sample size too small for any subgroup analysis. 5. CONFOUNDERS: This is a clear case of insufficient information - trial terminated before any meaningful efficacy readout due to enrollment failure during pandemic, not for scientific or safety reasons.

failure_modes.evidence: Trial terminated early with only 2 patients enrolled due to COVID-19 pandemic impact on accrual. No meaningful efficacy assessment possible with this sample size and short follow-up (median 53 days). Primary endpoint of intracranial PFS at 6 months could not be evaluated.
